mentions.name: Cross-platform keyboard-driven PDF reader
mentions.description: A native, cross-platform PDF reader with hot-reloading and keyboard navigation, inspired by zathura. Currently in a functional state and used by its builder, though still lacking some ergonomic features before wider use.
mentions.source_excerpt: A native PDF-reader with hot-reloading and keyboard navigation, obviously inspired by https://github.com/pwmt/zathura but also cross-platform.

evidence.value: A native PDF-reader with hot-reloading and keyboard navigation, obviously inspired by https://github.com/pwmt/zathura but also cross-platform.
